name: Gaussian splatting (3DGS) capture, edit, export
inclusion_rule: 3DGS training/viewers/editors (Splat.js, LichtFeld Studio, SplatPaint, brush selection), splat→mesh (Splat2Mesh, 3DGS Mesh Converter), splat repair (ArtiFixer), splat research (GaussianGPT, LightFuse), streaming/LOD, camera animation and 4K export from splats, splat→3D print.
exclusion_rule: Reconstruction that does not produce/consume splats → image-to-3d-world.
comparison_axes: export target (mesh, print, engine, web viewer)
open_questions: Which splat→mesh path survives print or engine collision?
Is ArtiFixer required on phone-captured splats or only on research scenes?
